title: ARSAS 1.6.39 stable release
summary: ARSAS 1.6.39 promotes the physically accepted P0.7 finishing line while preserving the proven static-report runtime and applying the final SCL semantic correction only at export.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.39 mempromosikan finishing P0.7 yang sudah diterima pada pengujian fisik, mempertahankan runtime static-report yang terbukti baik, dan menerapkan koreksi semantic SCL terakhir hanya pada saat export.
highlights: Discovery and monitoring preserve the accepted 58/58 static DataSet workflow: 22 Analog, 36 Digital, report-backed 58, and zero cyclic MMS process polling.
Live Values and Event Log keep CDC-aware visual semantics: DPC as [DP] Open [01] / Close [10], and SPS/SPC Boolean as [B] True [1] / False [0].
FAT Report Preview/PDF uses the same semantic display vocabulary as the live GUI while stored raw evidence remains unchanged.
Save SCL keeps the accepted live runtime untouched and corrects MPLS_GGIO1.CBClsCounter to INS / INT32 only in the serialized SCL before canonical reload validation.
highlightsId: Discovery dan monitoring mempertahankan workflow static DataSet 58/58 yang sudah diterima: 22 Analog, 36 Digital, 58 report-backed, dan tanpa cyclic MMS process polling.
Live Values dan Event Log mempertahankan semantic visual berbasis CDC: DPC sebagai [DP] Open [01] / Close [10], serta Boolean SPS/SPC sebagai [B] True [1] / False [0].
FAT Report Preview/PDF memakai vocabulary display semantic yang sama dengan GUI live sementara raw evidence yang tersimpan tetap tidak berubah.
Save SCL tidak mengubah runtime live yang sudah diterima dan mengoreksi MPLS_GGIO1.CBClsCounter menjadi INS / INT32 hanya pada SCL hasil serialisasi sebelum canonical reload validation.
improvements: The release source is promoted from the exact tested candidate tree and keeps ARIEC61850 pinned to the accepted engine commit.
Mainline, convergence, repeat-run, R7 interoperability, IO/SV, field-capture, post-merge production, full regression, publish and portable smoke gates are retained as fail-closed release evidence.
The SCL counter correction is isolated from discovery, MMS/ACSE/OSI, RCB planning, report decoding, monitoring, Event Log and FAT runtime paths.
Installer and portable packages are built from the same exact release source and published with SHA-256, provenance and SBOM evidence.
improvementsId: Source release dipromosikan dari exact tested candidate tree dan tetap mengunci ARIEC61850 pada engine commit yang sudah diterima.

Mainline, convergence, repeat-run, R7 interoperability, IO/SV, field-capture, post-merge production, full regression, publish dan portable smoke gate dipertahankan sebagai evidence release yang fail-closed.
Koreksi counter SCL diisolasi dari jalur discovery, MMS/ACSE/OSI, RCB planning, report decoding, monitoring, Event Log dan runtime FAT.
Paket Installer dan Portable dibangun dari source release yang sama persis dan dipublikasikan bersama evidence SHA-256, provenance dan SBOM.
knownLimitations: Physical relay validation remains necessary for vendor-specific values, report behavior and field network conditions that cannot be reproduced by CI.
Windows x64 is the only packaged desktop platform in this stable release.
The public portable binary is not Authenticode code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may show an unrecognized-publisher warning.
Raw-Ethernet GOOSE and Sampled Values workflows require an administrator-installed and approved Npcap driver, suitable capture permission and visibility of the relevant multicast traffic.
knownLimitationsId: Validasi relay fisik tetap diperlukan untuk value vendor-specific, perilaku report, dan kondisi network lapangan yang tidak dapat direproduksi oleh CI.
Windows x64 adalah satu-satunya platform desktop yang dipaketkan pada stable release ini.
Binary portable publik belum ditandatangani dengan Authenticode; Windows SmartScreen dapat menampilkan peringatan unrecognized publisher.
Workflow raw-Ethernet GOOSE dan Sampled Values memerlukan driver Npcap yang telah dipasang dan disetujui administrator, capture permission yang sesuai, serta visibility traffic multicast terkait.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binary do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul.
